  (K : Finset.{0} (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.Instance.Tm (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance.base g)))
  (j : Nat),
  LT.lt.{0} j
      (List.length.{0}
        (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.Instance.nodes (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance.base g))) →
    DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance.Pre g K
        (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.Instance.termD (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance.base g) ⋯ j) →
      Membership.mem.{0, 0} (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance.cutSet g hv K)
        (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} 2 (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance.repOf g j))

source.code:
theorem entry_mem_cutSet (K : Finset g.base.Tm) (j : ℕ) (hj : j < g.base.nodes.length)
    (hp : g.Pre K (g.base.termD (g.baseValid hv) j)) : 2 * g.repOf j ∈ g.cutSet hv K := by
  rw [g.mem_cutSet]
  refine ⟨(g.mem_netNodes _).mpr (Or.inl ⟨_, g.repOf_mem_reps hv j hj, rfl⟩),
    Or.inr ⟨?_, Or.inl ⟨by omega, ?_⟩⟩⟩
  · have := g.repOf_lt hv j hj; omega
  · have e : 2 * g.repOf j / 2 = g.repOf j := by omega
    rw [e, g.termD_repOf hv j hj]
    exact hp
